scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (process.env.INIT_CWD === __dirname) { console.error('\n❌ Do not install packages in the root directory! Change into /frontend or /backend first.\n'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('node_modules')) fs.rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true }); if (fs.existsSync('bun.lockb')) fs.rmSync('bun.lockb', { force: true }); if (fs.existsSync('bun.lock')) fs.rmSync('bun.lock', { force: true });"
